args.summary: The latest production deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks across regions. Per runbook, checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback executed and verified; service status confirmed.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 (latest) was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**. Rollback executed and verified, with change-manager approval.
3. **Confirmed recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy with a low error rate (~0.2%).
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failed deploy and the rollback; on-call has been paged.
